title: Real-Adapter Usage and Cost Evidence
description: GPP-3a (Faz 1) schema for per-run real-adapter usage/cost evidence. One artifact records a single adapter run (real or simulated): identity, elapsed time, prompt/completion tokens, total cost, the price catalog used to compute the cost, and an explicit unavailable_reason when usage data did not surface. The schema enforces two mutually exclusive evidence shapes via root oneOf: (a) unavailable_reason=null with non-null tokens+cost, or (b) unavailable_reason set to one of usage_missing/token_unavailable/cost_unavailable with explicitly null tokens+cost. evidence_class=simulated requires live_adapter_execution=false; evidence_class=live requires live_adapter_execution=true. The three GP-5/GPP-9 promotion guards (support_widening, production_platform_claim, live_adapter_execution top-level) all default to false at the const level for evidence_class=simulated. The artifact does NOT by itself close GP-5.9 BC-10; GPP-3b records the BC-10 closure path decision and GPP-3c executes it.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version. Must be the literal 'real-adapter-usage-cost-evidence.v1'.

evidence_class.description: simulated = no real provider API call; the artifact records a structured-fixture path proving the schema and reasoning shape (GPP-3a). live = a real adapter call against a real provider produced this evidence (GPP-3c Option X only; not used in the autonomous path).

adapter_id.description: Adapter identifier, for example 'anthropic-claude-3-5-sonnet'. No secret material.

model_id.description: Provider-canonical model identifier. Matches the spend ledger schema vendor_model_id or model where applicable.

run_id.description: Workflow run UUID. Matches workflow-run.schema.v1.json::run_id and spend-ledger.schema.v1.json::run_id.

step_id.description: Step within the workflow run. Opaque identifier assigned by the driver.

elapsed_seconds.description: Wall-clock time from invocation start to completion.

prompt_tokens.description: Prompt tokens consumed (includes cached). Null when unavailable_reason is non-null.

completion_tokens.description: Completion tokens generated. Null when unavailable_reason is non-null.

total_cost_usd.description: Total USD cost serialized as a decimal string (Decimal precision stability). Null when unavailable_reason is non-null. Computed via ao_kernel.cost.cost_math.compute_cost from the price catalog referenced by pricing_source.

currency.description: Currency contract. Only USD is supported in v1.

source_type.description: Where the price catalog used for cost computation came from. simulated_fixture is used by the GPP-3a simulated path; bundled_catalog references the ao_kernel.cost.catalog defaults; workspace_catalog/operator_supplied are for live evidence paths.

source_ref.description: Catalog path, registry id, or fixture name.

source_digest.description: Optional SHA-256 digest of the catalog contents at evidence emission time. Null when the catalog has no stable digest (e.g. simulated fixture).

retrieved_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp the catalog was retrieved. Null for simulated paths.

pricing_source.description: Structured reference to the price catalog used by cost_math.compute_cost. Required so a future verifier can replay cost computation deterministically.

unavailable_reason.description: When non-null, explains why prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/total_cost_usd are all null. usage_missing = adapter normalize_response did not surface tokens at all. token_unavailable = tokens reported but invalid/incomplete. cost_unavailable = tokens reported but no price catalog entry matched, so cost cannot be computed.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evidence artifact was emitted.

live_adapter_execution.description: True only when evidence_class is 'live'. Top-level guard mirrored from spend-ledger semantics; pins the artifact to the simulated path under the autonomous GPP-3 closure model.

support_widening.description: Always false. GPP-3a does NOT widen support; widening requires an explicit GPP-9 promotion decision (PROGRAM-CHANGE-CONTROL.md CC-6).

production_platform_claim.description: Always false. GPP-3a does NOT claim production platform readiness.

linked_spend_ledger_events.description: Optional cross-references to spend-ledger.v1.json events that contributed to this evidence artifact. Null on the simulated path (no spend ledger events emitted). One or more entries on the live path when ledger events exist.

oneOf.description: Complete evidence: usage and cost data are present.
Unavailable evidence: usage and cost are explicitly null with a documented reason.
